consequences.disallowanceSection: Section 43B(h) read with Section 43B - 100% disallowance of expenditure if payment not made within 45 days of written agreement
consequences.interestRate: No separate interest; disallowance results in higher taxable income taxed at applicable slab rates
consequences.penaltyProvisions: Section 271(1)(c) penalty up to 300% of tax evaded if concealment established; Section 270A penalty 50-200% for under-reporting/misreporting

formMsme1.applicableTo: All companies (except micro/small) receiving goods/services from MSME suppliers

udyamVerification.cacheStrategy: 24-hour TTL for supplier status; real-time verification before Form MSME-1 filing
